reason: Seven PyTorch servers each exposed 64 intra-op and 64 inter-op threads (324 OS threads/server); machine load was about 222 on 128 CPUs.

twelve_core_probe.reason: 33-36% idle CPU showed that 12 cores/server unnecessarily starved inference.

decision_rule: Keep only if per-shard durable-row throughput improves without crashes/timeouts; otherwise restore all seven servers to CPUs 0-127.

decision_evidence.interpretation: Disjoint affinity left usable CPUs idle while server threads waited on their restricted masks; no reliable unique-row throughput gain had been established.
